headlines.summary: ■ ‘부동산 증세’에 안정성 악화 전세가율 17개월만에 오름세 “보유세 인상, 세입자에게 전가” 15일 오전 불암산 전망대에서 바라본 노원구 아파트 단지들. 박윤슬 기자 정부가 부동산 증세를 사실상 기정사실화한 가운데 서울 아파트 전세가 상승률이 매매가 상승률을 앞질러 임대차 시장 불안감이 증폭되고 있다.

headlines.title: “ 월세, 반년만 두배 폭등 ”… 서울 156만원 ‘ 역대 최고 ’ [부동산 증세...
headlines.summary: 5월 월세 1년전보다 10.6% 급상승 ‘월세 300만원 이상’ 작년보다 2%P↑ “보유세 강화 땐 전·월세난 더 심화” #. 강동구 둔촌동에 소재한 올림픽파크포레온 84㎡는 지난 1월 15일 보증금 1억원·월세 150만원에 월세 계약이 이뤄졌다.

headlines.title: 경매도 뜨겁다, 시세보다 수천만원 비싸도 낙찰
headlines.summary: 동탄구, 감정가보다 낙찰가 높아 경기도 화성시 동탄 아파트 단지 전경 모습. /오종찬 기자 삼성전자 성과급과 증시 활황 등의 여파로 경기 화성시 동탄의 아파트 가격이 단시간 내에 가파르게 오르면서 이 지역 아파트 경매 시장도 활발해지고 있다.

headlines.title: 블룸버그 "MSCI 신흥시장 4년만 의 깜짝실적 …삼전닉스 등 주도"
headlines.summary: 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스를 비롯한 한국 반도체 기업들이 신흥시장(EM) 기업들의 4년 만의 이익 반등을 이끌며 글로벌 강세장의 핵심 동력으로 떠오르고 있다고 블룸버그 통신이 현지시각 21일 보도했습니다. 블룸버그에 따르면 MSCI(모건스탠리캐피털인터내셔널) 신흥시장 지수 편입 기업들의 가중 평균 주당순이익(EPS)은 지난달까지 12개월 기준 95.

headlines.title: 반도체 슈퍼랠리로 수출 호황 … 역대급 실적 뒤 ‘ K-양극화 ’
headlines.summary: 620억 달러 중 반도체비중 41% 승용차 2.3% 증가로 제자리걸음 6월 중순까지 수출이 반도체 호황에 힘입어 동 기간 기준 역대 최대를 기록했다. 다만 반도체를 제외한 주력 품목은 제자리걸음에 그치면서 ‘K자 양극화’가 굳어지는 모습이다. 관세청이 22일 발표한 ‘6월 1∼20일 수출입 현황(잠정치)’에 따르면 이 기간 수출액은 전년 동기 대비 60.

headlines.title: K-뷰티·건자재 …“ 전쟁 끝, 마진 회복할까 ”
headlines.summary: 올해 중기 4대 소비재 수출 16.4%↑ K-뷰티 40억9000만달러 역대 1위도 나프타 수급 회복·유가 하락 기대중 미국과 이란의 종전 합의 소식에 원자재 공급난으로 어려움을 겪었던 건자재 업종 기업들도 실적 회복을 기대하고 있다.  사진은 플라스틱 포장재가 전시된 서울 시내 한 시장 업체 모습.

headlines.title: 전기요금 3분기 도 동결 …한전 재무 부담 지속
headlines.summary: 한국전력 본사 전경 정부가 올해 3분기(7~9월) 전기요금을 동결했다. 국제 연료가격 하락으로 연료비조정단가 인하 요인이 발생했지만, 한국전력공사의 재무 상황과 미조정 요금을 고려한 조치다. 물가 안정과 국민 부담 완화에는 도움이 되지만, 한전 재무정상화와 전력망 투자 재원 확보 과제는 계속 숙제로 남게 됐다.

headlines.title: 3분기 전기요금 도 ' 동결 ' 유력…폭염 속 커지는 한전 '역마진' 경고등

headlines.title: 정년 연장 · 집단소송 확대 … “또 기업 옥죄기 법안” 재계 한숨
headlines.summary: 與, 7~8월 정년 65세 입법 추진 의무공개매수제 등 법제화 대기 배임죄 완화 등 ‘당근’은 하세월 인건비 상승·채용 축소 가능성 기업 경쟁력 약화 부작용 우려 의석 179석을 지킨 채 국회 후반기를 맞은 범여권이 친노동 및 경영권 규제 강화 법안 처리를 예고하고 있어 산업계가 초긴장하고 있다.

headlines.title: [Why&Next] 고용유지지원금 , 대상 2배 늘었지만 수급액·기간 ' 뚝 '

key_headlines.title: Seoul Monthly Rent Doubles in Six Months, Hits Record High of 1.56 Million Won
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment monthly rents surged 10.6% year-over-year in May, with rents exceeding 3 million won increasing by 2 percentage points. Property tax strengthening is expected to worsen housing affordability issues.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Export Boom Masks 'K-Shaped Polarization' in Korean Economy
key_headlines.summary: Semiconductors accounted for 41% of Korea's $62 billion exports in mid-June, hitting record highs, while non-semiconductor sectors like automobiles stagnated at 2.3% growth. The economy faces widening disparities between booming chip makers and struggling traditional industries.

key_headlines.title: July Property Tax Hike Becomes Official: Enhanced Ownership and Transfer Taxes Planned
key_headlines.summary: The government is set to announce comprehensive real estate tax reforms in late July, including increased property holding taxes and capital gains taxes. The measures aim to curb speculative investment and redirect semiconductor-driven liquonity away from real estate.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse (Lease) Prices Rise Faster Than Sale Prices Amid Housing Market Uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: Seoul jeonse prices showed their highest weekly increase in 17 months as tenants face rising rental burdens from anticipated property tax increases. Nationwide apartment markets recorded simultaneous price increases across 16 of 17 provinces.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Breaks 9,000 Mark as Individual Investors Eye 10,000 Target for Year
key_headlines.summary: Half of domestic investors predict KOSPI will exceed 10,000 in 2026, with interest rates and exchange rates identified as the most influential variables. The semiconductor rally continues to drive market gains, though concentration risk remains elevated.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing acute polarization, with semiconductor exports reaching record highs while traditional sectors struggle. Seoul's monthly rent prices have doubled within six months, hitting an all-time high of 1.56 million won, creating severe housing affordability crises. The government is addressing these imbalances through planned property tax increases in July, alongside efforts to stabilize real estate prices. Jeonse prices are rising faster than purchase prices, signaling tenant distress and market instability. Overall, semiconductor-led export success masks deepening structural economic inequalities across industries.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Fiscal experts have urged the government to allocate record tax revenues toward future investments and emergency reserves rather than immediate spending increases. The Ministry of Strategy and Finance acknowledged unprecedented revenue but highlighted significant uncertainties from semiconductor cycle sustainability, inflation, and interest rate volatility. Discussions focused on mandatory expenditure reforms to address structural budget rigidity beyond discretionary spending cuts. Record tax surpluses driven by semiconductor exports present both opportunities for long-term investment and risks if economic conditions deteriorate. International comparisons to Australia and other countries suggest establishing sovereign wealth funds to manage cyclical economic booms.
sections.Financial Markets: KOSPI surpassed 9,000 points as individual investors show bullish sentiment, with half expecting the index to reach 10,000 by year-end. Interest rates and exchange rates remain the dominant market variables at 58.7% importance, followed by oil prices and geopolitical risks. The won-dollar exchange rate has stabilized around 1,500 won, providing relative predictability to equity valuations. Hawkish Federal Reserve policy messaging appears to have diminishing market impact as semiconductor strength sustains gains. However, significant concentration in large-cap semiconductor stocks raises concerns about market breadth and KOSDAQ's weak performance reflects diminishing individual investor participation.
sections.Industry & Technology: China is accelerating semiconductor and EV technological advancement through state-sponsored initiatives, with major memory chip makers preparing initial public offerings. Korea's automotive sector is requesting government incentive programs for domestic EV production as the industry transitions toward future mobility. Semiconductor boom benefits are unevenly distributed, with secondary battery and clean room equipment suppliers facing demand weakness from slowing EV adoption. The semiconductor industry's prosperity contrasts sharply with struggling component suppliers dependent on automotive and battery sectors. Industry experts emphasize the need for comprehensive ecosystem support beyond semiconductor companies to sustain Korea's manufacturing competitiveness.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment prices are rising in tandem with jeonse prices, creating widespread housing market instability across 16 of 17 provinces. Small-scale reconstruction projects in Gangnam are reaccelerating due to rising property values, though financing constraints limit development momentum. Jeonse loan regulations have become a focal point for government intervention as the lending practice is partially blamed for price increases. Upscale reconstruction projects like Songpa Hanyang apartments are advancing as investors seek to capitalize on price appreciation. The government's upcoming tax increases are expected to further pressure renters while potentially tempering speculative buying, though affordability continues deteriorating.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve eliminated forward guidance and point-of-dot projections under new Chair Powell, creating market uncertainty about future rate direction. Analysts warn that removing forward guidance communication tools could lead to higher interest rates and increased market volatility. Former Federal Reserve Chair Alan Greenspan passed away at age 100; he was credited with enhancing Fed transparency through expanded policy communication during his 19-year tenure. China maintained its benchmark lending rate unchanged for 13 consecutive months amid mixed economic signals, with retail sales and exports showing divergent trends. Global economic uncertainty persists as U.S. monetary policy communication becomes less transparent while international oil prices and geopolitical tensions remain elevated.
sections.AI & Economy: AI infrastructure investment expansion poses structural concerns for debt markets as companies commit massive capital to GPU and computing resources. Generative AI affects approximately 24% of global employment according to the International Labour Organization, raising questions about job displacement versus creation. Korean IT companies are restructuring toward AI-centric business models, with one KOSDAQ firm transitioning from ad agencies to brand-platform-AI content operations. AI infrastructure company Ten revealed cost-reduction solutions for expensive GPU operations, addressing a major barrier to AI service deployment. Concerns grow about whether AI benefits will concentrate among mega-cap technology firms or distribute more broadly across the economy.
sections.Others: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella emphasized that AI economic gains should not be monopolized by large technology companies alone. China imposed sanctions on ten U.S. defense, drone, and rare earth companies in response to U.S. restrictions on Chinese firms like Alibaba and BYD. Eight out of ten South Koreans rely on foreign AI services, creating vulnerability to temporary outages and international policy changes. Gyeonggi Province faces a 7 trillion won budget shortfall due to declining real estate transaction taxes from reduced property market activity. SpaceX IPO inclusion in Korean ETF products raised fraud investigation concerns regarding marketing claims and product transparency.
